defaultValue.description: Default value for the input component.

onClick.description: Callback function called when the input is clicked.

onChange.description: Callback function called when the input value changes.

inputRef.description: Ref to the native input element.

disabled.description: Flag to indicate if the input is disabled.

React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>.description: A union type of all possible shapes for React refs.

React.RefCallback<HTMLInputElement>.description: A callback fired whenever the ref's value changes.
